senses.gloss: शुङ्ग m. (etymology doubtful) the Indian fig-tree (= वट), L.
Ficus Infectoria, L.
Spondias Mangifera, L.
the awn of corn, L.
the sheath or calyx of a bud, L.
N. of a man (pl. his descendants), Pravar. (cf. Pāṇ. iv, 1, 117)
pl. N. of a dynasty which succeeded the Mauryas (sg. a king of the Ś˚ dyn˚), Pur.
शुङ्ग n. the sheath or calyx of a bud, (fig.) effect (opp. to मूल, ‘cause’), ChUp.
Ficus Infectoria, L.
शुङ्गा॑ (आ॑), f., see below
शुङ्गा॑ f. the sheath or calyx of a young bud (esp. of a fig-tree), GṛS.; Suśr.
the awn of barley &c., a bristle, L.
the waved-leaf fig-tree, W.
N. of the mother of Garuḍa, Suparṇ.
शुङ्गी (ई), f. Spondias Mangifera, L.
Ficus Infectoria, L.
N. of the mother of Garuḍa, Suparṇ.
शुङ्ग—राजन् m. a king of the Śuṅga dynasty, VP.
शुङ्गा—कर्मन् n. a ceremony connected with the Puṃ-savana (q.v.) at which the calyx of a young bud of the Ficus Indica is used, Gṛhyās.
शुङ्गिन् mfn. having a sheath or calyx, MW.
furnished with an awn, ib.
शुङ्गिन् m. Ficus Indica or Infectoria, L.
